prompt: With flippy1, which is at the fryer, wait up to 2 minutes for the oil in oil_1 to read above 170 degrees Celsius. As soon as it does, send channel "fry" how long the job has taken so far, then move basket_2 from the prep_table to the fryer. If the oil does not get there, stop.

paths.when: the oil reaches 175 degC at 20 s: the time is sent, the basket is moved
the oil never heats: the run stops

world_1_5.note: no clock needed: `elapsed` after the wait, which is the first step (20 s)

why: The time the heating took is `elapsed` read right after the wait, because the wait is the first step (the robot starts at the fryer, so the contact probe reads at once). 1.8 has no `elapsed` (0042 T1); the standing `x05_cooling_time` is this shape. A reading taken after the move would include the move.
